name: quad_dec_regs
desc: Quadrature decoder: control and filter, position, velocity, window, status, error count, index position.

fields.name: INDEX_CLR
fields.desc: 1: the index edge clears the position

registers.name: POSITION
registers.desc: signed position (x4 counts); a write loads it

registers.name: VELOCITY
registers.desc: signed counts in the last window

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: status; write 1 to [2:1] to clear those flags

fields.name: DIR
fields.desc: direction of the last step (1 = up)

registers.name: INDEX_POS
registers.desc: position at the last index edge
